file_document_surfer.description: Document-reading specialist. Use it for local PDF, DOCX, and PPTX attachments after a path is known. It extracts text from documents and answers questions grounded in document contents. It should not be used for spreadsheets, images, audio, web pages, or general computation.

skills.name: read_pdf
skills.description: Read a local PDF file and extract page text.

skills.name: read_docx
skills.description: Read a local DOCX file and extract paragraph text.

skills.name: read_pptx
skills.description: Read a local PPTX file and extract text from slides.

file_table_surfer.description: Table-analysis specialist. Use it for local CSV and Excel attachments after a path is known. It inspects tabular data, columns, rows, summary statistics, and spreadsheet sheets. It should not be used for PDFs, images, audio, web lookup, or free-form coding unless another agent needs deeper computation.

skills.name: analyze_csv_file
skills.description: Inspect a local CSV file and return shape, columns, sample rows, and summary statistics.

skills.name: analyze_excel_file
skills.description: Inspect a local Excel file or sheet and return shape, columns, sample rows, and summary statistics.

file_image_surfer.description: Image-analysis specialist. Use it for local images, screenshots, scanned pages, charts, diagrams, and photos after a path is known. It can OCR text from images and ask a vision-capable model about visual content. It should not be used for documents, spreadsheets, audio, or web pages.

skills.name: extract_text_from_image
skills.description: Run OCR with pytesseract on a local image file and return extracted text.

skills.name: analyze_image_with_llm
skills.description: Ask a vision-capable Azure OpenAI model a question about a local image file.

file_audio_surfer.description: Audio-transcription specialist. Use it for local audio attachments after a path is known. It transcribes speech recordings and returns transcript text. It should not be used for documents, spreadsheets, images, web pages, or general computation.

skills.name: transcribe_audio
skills.description: Transcribe a local audio file using local Whisper and return the transcript text.
